TEXT:
And so, I'm searching around the park for my 
girlfriend.

Hm? She did say we were going to meet here, 
right...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
I hope it wasn't a bother? Calling you out so 
suddenly...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Not at all. Haha, I wanted to see you, too, anyway.

The discrepancy between her different 
appearances still boggles my mind.
Just in case, perhaps I should explain...

She has a bandana tied above her swirly glasses, 
with a tucked-in, checkered shirt.

An oddball who dresses in typical otaku fashion and 
uses a samurai's way of speaking.
That's the appearance of the Saori I know well.
Are these two people really the very same...

SPEAKER: SPK_BAJEENA
TEXT:
Is something the matter, Kyousuke-shi? You have 
been staring at me.

SPEAKER: SPK_BAJEENA
TEXT:
Haha, so, perhaps you have been charmed by my 
good looks? ♪

TEXT: Kyousuke-san... please don't stare at me like that.
